label_id: Stable record identity. A row can hold multiple parameters from one biochemical observation; it is not several independent experiments.
experimental_complex_pdb_ids: Public experimental enzyme/cofactor/real substrate or product complexes associated with this biochemical reaction; state/quality limitations remain in structure_manifest.
experimental_protein_pdb_ids: Public experimental protein scaffold for the reported enzyme core; not a claim of target substrate pose or exact terminal construct match.
template_pdb_ids: Templates only, never substituted for an experimental mutant complex.
Km_comparator: = for point estimates; < for a reported upper bound. A numeric Km_value_or_bound_M must be read with this field.
efficiency_reported_M_1_s_1: Unit conversion of the published efficiency. Can differ from a ratio of rounded kcat and Km.
efficiency_ratio_derived_M_1_s_1: Ratio of central values only when Km is a positive point value; no propagated uncertainty. Not a published fitted efficiency.
record_status: measured_numeric, measured_apparent_numeric, or not_determined. null is missing, never zero.
strict_geometry_gold: Always false in this release; audited candidates still have state, density, conformer or local-geometry limitations.
selected_altloc: Candidate preparation choice, not an independent experimental replicate or a re-refined model.
linked_label_ids: All associated records, including template-only mutant uses. Use the separate experimental_complex/protein/template fields in activity_labels to determine the actual evidence relationship.
split_group: Conservative parent-enzyme grouping. Family-level grouping can need to be broader; do not split close homologs simply because IDs differ.
sequence_kind: See sequence_manifest: source sequences and derived sequences are explicitly separated.
assay_group: Protocol/source grouping for conditional interpretation. Different source groups are not automatically comparable.
